title: Minimum cuts for finite envy-free cake-cutting protocols
area: Algorithmic game theory, mechanism design and fair division
formal: For each n, what is the minimum number of cuts sufficient for a finite Robertson–Webb protocol that allocates the whole cake envy-freely among n agents?
context:
Agents have nonatomic normalized nonnegative additive valuations; disconnected bundles are permitted. Cuts are counted separately from evaluation queries.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Separates the complexity of an allocation's geometry from the amount of information a protocol obtains.
